import subprocess
r=subprocess.run(['node','-e',"try{const fs=require('node:fs'),assert=require('node:assert/strict'),holder={exports:{}};new Function('module','globalThis',fs.readFileSync('mission_control/static/discovery-model.js','utf8').replace(/^export /gm,''))(holder,{});let result;try{result=typeof holder.exports.integer==='function'?holder.exports.integer('100000','Views',0,1e12):undefined;}catch(e){result=undefined;}assert.equal(result,100000,'Observed view count must be preserved exactly');let rejected=false;try{holder.exports.integer('01','Views',0,1e12);}catch(e){rejected=true;}assert.equal(rejected,true,'Ambiguous view counts must be rejected');}catch(e){process.stderr.write(e.name+': '+e.message.split('\\n')[0]+'\\n');process.exit(1);}"],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert r.returncode==0,r.stdout+r.stderr
